purpose: Document first-party local registry/viewer evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Anonymous viewer selectors resolved state 09, district Moradabad 135, tehsil 00719, village 220922 (कस्वा मुरादाबाद, hasData=true). Official getVVVVExtentGeoref for this selected village returned EPSG:32644 bounds x=282238.4922..285220.2884, y=3190220.2012..3193135.5627. The WUP point transformed to EPSG:32644 is approximately [281247.06,3191939.71], about 991 m west of that village extent. Control village 220927 (छावनी, hasData=false) returned a zero extent. This does not resolve neighboring-village coverage. Viewer getPlotAtXY returns an unfiltered interactive parcel info object with no safe allowlist; it was not called. WMS is raster rendering, not verified full-vector geometry. Which revenue village or urban parcel service covers the WUP locator; whether an anonymous geometry-only endpoint is available for that exact area.
